resources.name: voteproof-inventory-test-23dad6c5dc
resources.cleanup_confirmation: Worker, bucket and D1 each returned HTTP404 after deletion. Only synthetic isolated objects deleted.

change.A: Replace generic authAtomic INSERT guard + UPDATE + DELETE guard with one atomic UPDATE WHERE id/version/phase/reserved predicates RETURNING inventory_version.
change.B: Unmodified; same guarded atomic multi-statement transaction.
change.A1_A2_assessment: Not adopted. Persisting a pending page would add at least one durable write/read pair, another authenticated HTTP call per page and a pending-result recovery contract; native LIST and metadata cost stay in A1. No demonstrated advantage versus removing two redundant page SQL statements while retaining single-statement CAS.

baseline_outlier.cause_limit: No stage-level native CPU attribution available; no extra application JSON, objects or SQL relative to same page. Do not claim GC/JIT, host load, or D1 as a proven sole root cause.

methodology.native_cpu_source: Independent trace-v1 and Wrangler CLI cpuTime, joined by exact sample ID. No wall-time substitution, no CPU addition across invocations.
methodology.harness_overhead: Isolated budget UPDATE/trip and small log included; not subtracted.
methodology.reference: 40 complete scans compared against original handler on identical native isolated R2 bucket. No Production resources or real Google Script/API calls this round.
limitations: Finite isolated evidence does not guarantee zero future CPU tail spikes.
Not an interleaved A/B causal percentage comparison.
New Apps Script two-request orchestration has local coverage; no new real Apps Script deployment authorized this round.

tests.environment: Initial sandbox loopback/local R2 access failures; same exact related suites passed outside sandbox without product changes.
